A background can be a video now, and the: A background can be a video now, and the lock screen shows a still from it.
A treemap of your disk that flags the ca: A treemap of your disk that flags the caches that are safe to clear. It replaces Disk Usage.
Add Mozc, Hangul, Pinyin, Zhuyin or Cang: Add Mozc, Hangul, Pinyin, Zhuyin or Cangjie under Setup > Keyboard, then switch with Super + I.
Calculator is Super + Shift + Q, Activit: Calculator is Super + Shift + Q, Activity is Super + Shift + T and Network is Super + Ctrl + N. Super + Ctrl + T now opens themes and Super + Ctrl + W backgrounds. Nightlight lost its hotkey; it's under Trigger > Toggle.
Control another Omarchy machine over SSH: Control another Omarchy machine over SSH, one tab per machine, with nothing to set up.
Disktree shows what fills your disk: Disktree shows what fills your disk
Each monitor has its own workspaces: Each monitor has its own workspaces
New default hotkeys may collide with you: New default hotkeys may collide with yours
Pin cities on a globe and name the peopl: Pin cities on a globe and name the people in each, right next to the clock.
Place your saved signature, text and dat: Place your saved signature, text and dates on a PDF and save a signed copy.
Record yourself on camera with one key,: Record yourself on camera with one key, themed to match your desktop.
Super + 1 to 0 goes to the workspaces of: Super + 1 to 0 goes to the workspaces of the monitor you're on, and Super + Tab stays on it too.
Super + Comma acts on the newest card: d: Super + Comma acts on the newest card: dismiss it, open it, or press its button. Super + Ctrl + Comma hands you the keyboard to work through all of them.
Super + L cycles a workspace between til: Super + L cycles a workspace between tiling, scrolling and floating. Floating windows get titlebars and a dock, and Super + M minimizes a window to it.
Super + ~ drops a console over the deskt: Super + ~ drops a console over the desktop and starts your default agent. Press it again to hide it; the session keeps running.
Tap Alt + Space to start and stop, or ho: Tap Alt + Space to start and stop, or hold Right Alt to talk. F9 and Super + Ctrl + X keep working.
The Appearance menu picks opaque, transp: The Appearance menu picks opaque, transparent or glassy windows, and sharp, rounded or theme corners.
The agents panel tracks 23 agents with a: The agents panel tracks 23 agents with a meter for each limit. Keep several Claude, Codex and Grok logins and switch when one runs low.
The menus, the desktop and notifications: The menus, the desktop and notifications switch right away, and apps follow as you open them.
Two new bundled themes, and a theme can: Two new bundled themes, and a theme can play a short intro when you switch to it.
Write slides in one Markdown file with a: Write slides in one Markdown file with a visual editor beside it, and export to PDF or PowerPoint.
You keep your own bindings, and these ar: You keep your own bindings, and these are defaults now too: Super + Q, Super + A, Super + M, Super + ~, Super + Alt + L, Super + Ctrl + Alt + C, E and F, and holding Right Alt.
